rules.title: Planned is not observed
rules.description: A planned test has no observed outcome and cannot support a claim.

rules.title: Fuel phase must match
rules.description: Solid, liquid and aerosol records answer different questions.

rules.title: Material identity
rules.description: Results are material-specific; a different material is not evidence for this material.

rules.title: Geometry shape must match
rules.description: Rod, sheet, droplet and aerosol geometries are not interchangeable.

rules.title: Thickness/diameter closeness
rules.description: Characteristic dimension affects thermal regime; differing or non-comparable values limit transfer.

rules.title: Substrate/confinement
rules.description: A backing substrate or confinement changes heat loss and flow.

rules.title: Gravity regime must match
rules.description: Microgravity, partial and normal gravity flames are different regimes.

rules.title: Actual versus simulated gravity
rules.description: A simulated or analogue low-gravity record does not carry actual-microgravity evidence.

rules.title: Flow direction
rules.description: Concurrent, opposed and quiescent flow are different spread regimes.

rules.title: Endpoint needs a flow reduction
rules.description: Extinction under flow reduction needs a run in which flow was reduced.

rules.title: Initial flow velocity closeness
rules.description: Initial flow differences limit transfer.

rules.title: Flow history
rules.description: Same initial flow with a different reduction history is a different condition.

rules.title: O2 role: ambient versus oxidizer stream
rules.description: An ambient fraction and an oxidizer-stream fraction are not the same quantity.

rules.title: O2 fraction closeness
rules.description: Oxygen differences beyond tolerance limit transfer.

rules.title: Pressure closeness
rules.description: Pressure differences beyond tolerance limit transfer.

rules.title: Ignition method
rules.description: Different ignition methods limit ignition-endpoint transfer.

rules.title: Endpoint-to-event mapping
rules.description: The endpoint must correspond to a recorded event; operator termination is not extinction.

rules.title: Hot extinction with continued cool burning
rules.description: Loss of the hot flame is not final extinction when cool burning continues.

rules.title: Endpoint must be stated
rules.description: Without an endpoint no event mapping is possible.

rules.title: Single changed factor
rules.description: A comparison is only allowed when exactly one recorded parameter differs.

rules.title: Unknown fields block a comparison
rules.description: Unknown on either side means the factor may differ; it is never a match.

rules.title: Same initial flow, different history
rules.description: Equal initial flow does not make flow conditions equal when the history differs.

rules.title: No causal claim
rules.description: A contrast reports a difference between records, never a demonstrated cause.

rules.title: Outcome not comparable
rules.description: A run that did not reach the endpoint cannot be compared as if it had.

rules.title: Claim status from applicability
rules.description: direct -> supported; limited_context -> needs_new_comparison; otherwise not_applicable.

extinction_under_flow_reduction.needs: a flow reduction step and an extinction event (not operator termination)

cool_burning.needs: hot extinction followed by continued cool burning

suppression.needs: an intervention/gas-change step and an extinction event
